entries.title: Move between a card's questions on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, when a decision asks several questions, its picked count is now a stepper: tap the arrows beside it to bring the previous or next question into view, or tap the count to go to the next one still unanswered. With a keyboard, ⌘J and ⇧⌘J move between the questions, and Enter and the number keys answer them.

picture.alt: The foot of a decision card on an iPad, with arrows on either side of its 0 of 3 picked count, beside its choices
